native_builds.production_host: passed private theme-lab build; not installed

negative_attempt.error: GDK BadWindow, request10, when cleaning a surface destroyed by host disconnect
negative_attempt.correction: After verified host/child loss only, bracket GTK window destruction in GDK X11 error trap. Accept Success or BadWindow; raise on other errors. No global ignore policy.

scope: Validate marked InputOutput canvas against expected PID/UID; Python also checks process start ticks and main thread. Marker is coordination, not shared-X-server security.
Refuse missing canvas and unowned child before attachment; native X errors captured on bridge-owned connection.
Resize GTK4 native fixed allocation from360x240 to420x280 following actual Motif canvas, preserving independent button recipe geometry.
Detect host process exit and canvas destruction while process remains alive; cleanup idempotent and expected BadWindow trapped narrowly.
Transient process observation OSError propagates and keeps the handle, rather than claiming host death.
limits: Bridge not yet wired to public preview entry point, generation receipts or controller routing.
XEmbed is not emulated. Inter-toolkit focus/Tab, WM behavior and full process event/watch protocol pending.
No GTK4 editable control exists in this stage; no claim about text recovery after host loss.
Runtime C99 host compiled but actual production UI not reopened/tested with GTK4. Fixture used the same canvas identity publication header.
No new drawing or palette changes; reuse four-palette session evidence for unchanged masks. No historical fidelity or human approval claimed.
Current GDK X11 ABI includes deprecated functions; no Wayland/future-version guarantee.

progress.basis: Four equal milestones: foundation1, session2.5 of4 gates, controller0, delivery0 =>40.625%, rounded41. Host identity/resize/loss proved; host gate still partial until focus protocol integrated.
